gold.user: User wants to retrieve a list of all reminders they have set in Zulip. They expect to see details such as the reminder message, time, and any associated stream or topic.
gold.ideal: A successful response with a JSON array of reminders, each containing id, content, time, and related stream/topic information.

gold.user: User wants to create a new reminder for an important message in Zulip. They provide the message content, the time for the reminder, and optionally the stream and topic to which it relates.
gold.ideal: A successful response confirming the creation of the reminder, including the reminder id and the details of the reminder that was created.

gold.user: User wants to delete a specific reminder that they no longer need. They provide the reminder_id of the reminder they wish to remove.
gold.ideal: A successful response indicating that the reminder has been deleted, along with a confirmation message.
